facts.value: This course aims to impart communicative and intercultural foreign language skills, refresh and complete existing basic knowledge in the Spanish language, and provide foundational vocabulary as well as an initial insight into general aspects of the economy of Spain and Latin America.
Completion of level A1 of the GER or 40 – 60 points in the placement test.

In the course Business Spanish 1 – Base, you will learn vocabulary and expressions specifically for the business world, gain extensive knowledge of the Spanish language, and receive insights into the country, its society, and issues concerning business life such as entrepreneurship, marketing strategies, and economic trends. A variety of exercises will also foster linguistic and conceptual understanding of current topics and lay the foundation for discussions and written exercises on various business topics.
Oral participation and presentation, written exam in the last week of lectures. A graded certificate will be issued for successful completion of the exams.
Completion of level A2 of the GER or at least 60 points in the placement test.

In the course Business Spanish 2 – Consolidation, you will learn vocabulary and expressions specifically for the business world, gain extensive knowledge of the Spanish language, and receive insights into the country, its society, and issues concerning business life such as entrepreneurship, marketing strategies, and economic trends.
